notes.title: Fort Assault and Arcade Update
notes.content:
If you've sunken all the foes in Hunt and breached the line in Blockade Runner, get ready for the next addition to Helm or High Water; Fort Assault!

In Fort Assault, the only objective is to destroy the Fort, but it may not be as easy as it sounds!

First, you'll have to sink the ships protecting it, making sure to stay out of the Fort's range. Then, the main challenge begins! Forts are formidable enemies with more cannons and more durability than you, but they cannot repair their stone walls.

Can you and your crew out-maneuver the giant and live to sail another day? 

Balance adjustments have been made to Blockade Runner as well as many optimizations to the home island, crew npcs, and ships. I also began work on adding VR-to-VR, cooperative, multiplayer, but you'll have to wait for a future update to give that a try.

Additionally, this update includes some launch commands that will be useful to arcades and streamers that auto-play the tutorial and spawn some hand held camera objects, respectively.

See below for the full update notes.

Full Update Notes
[list]
[*] New Game Mode: Fort Assault. Destroy the enemy fort and the ships protecting it! Forts have increased durability and firepower, but cannot repair
[*] Began the backend work to add VR-to-VR, cooperative, multiplayer
[*] MANY optimizations to both the home island, npcs, and ships should increase frame rates for most users
[*] Balance adjustments have been made to the new Blockade Runner game mode
[*] Added several launch option commands including...
[list]
[*] -arcade offers the tutorial every time the game is launched
[*] -streamer enables the hand held camera tools for capturing game footage and hides join UI
[*] -nolocalcoop disallows local co-op player from joining and hides join UI
[/list]
[*] More small bug fixes and changes
[/list]

notes.title: Singleplayer and Language Update
notes.content:
Full Update Notes
[list]
	[*] Added Singleplayer support
		[list][*] Crew Player can drop in and out at any time
		[*] Singleplayer controls Anchor and Ammo type with objects near the Map[/list]
	[*] Localized game into 9 new languages
	[list][*] Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portugese, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese[/list]
	[*] New game mode: Blockade Runner
		[list][*] Deliver the cargo to the fort undamaged for the full reward
		[*] A blockade of ships and forts blocks your path[/list]
	[*] New enemy factions: English and Spanish Navy
	[*] New enemy type: Fort
	[*] New sounds for hull damage, cargo damage, stone impact, ship low hp, ship sinking, and cannon reloading	
	[*] Upgraded Enemy AI now allocates crew members, utilizes all ammo types, and has better aim
	[*] Added playable Concertina object. Unlockable at Weaponsmith
	[*] Helm Enemy can now be killed to stop an enemy ship from manuvering for 30 seconds
	[*] Crew player input now auto switches between controller and keyboard input
	[*] Fixed multiple issues with boarding enemies' sword mechanics
	[*] Boarding enemies now spawn in groups of between 1 and 4
	[*] Tweaked ship smoke and sinking effects
	[*] Optimized performance
	[*] Many more small bug fixes and changes
[/list]

notes.title: Audio and Oculus Support Update
notes.content:
Added a couple of small audio features and bug fixes as well as full support for Oculus family devices. If grabbed objects feel oriented wrong on your controllers toggle the setting in the options menu outside the player house.

Full Update Notes
[list]
[*] NEW Doppler effect sounds for cannonballs
[*] NEW Cannonball splash sounds
[*] NEW Cannon fire sounds
[*] NEW Sounds for items sockets
[*] NEW Anchor rework, with sound
[*] NEW Grab Pose options for Oculus controllers
[*] FIX Teleport control binding for all thumbstick controllers
[*] FIX Teleport beam no longer allows you to teleport into water
[*] FIX Spyglass grab attach point
[*] FIX Double pistol can no longer be spam fired
[*] FIX Sockets should no longer occasionally fail to grab dropped objects
[*] FIX Flicker on scene load for some headsets
[*] FIX Contact sounds no longer play in the first 5 seconds
[*] CHANGE Boarder enemy spawn change reduced from 100% to 50%
[/list]

notes.title: Swordplay and Style Update
notes.content:
Prepare to be boarded!

The Swordplay and Style Update brings several new mechanics to the game as well as 5 new maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41768675/f81541b8247351a2ab68411f0662f492894e6b16.png[/img]

Sword enemies clinging to the ropes of their ship will jump aboard if you let them get close enough. Make sure you've stocked up on swords and guns from the weaponsmith.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41768675/9bfc8686b4835c885b87c504945161464e18a0fc.png[/img]

If you survive the encounter, ditch the sea soaked rags and dress to impress with coats, gloves, hats, eyepatches, earrings, and beards to boot from the new Clothing Vendor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41768675/d06ecaa1a47fcb4f9c882b5da255d26c4211df2a.png[/img]

Cannonball trajectory indication lines make it much easier as the Crew to aim the cannons.

The enemy ship AI has also been retooled, increasing the pace and the challenge of the game. Enemies now deftly avoid crashing (except with you), get back on track more quickly, and aim their cannons.

And much more! Check out the full notes below.

Full Update Notes
[list]
[*] NEW Sword Combat with enemy boarders who jump onto your ship
[*] NEW VR player is now damageable with visual, audio, and ragdoll effects
[*] NEW Clothing vendor
[*] NEW Character appearance UI
[*] NEW 5 Voyage maps
[*] NEW Post-voyage summary screen
[*] NEW Options menu outside player home
[*] NEW Option for VR grab: click or hold 
[*] NEW Option: Wave height slider
[*] NEW Cannonball trajectory indicators
[*] NEW Improved ship AI is much better at aiming and avoiding crashes
[*] NEW Random wave height on voyages
[*] NEW Invisible teleport surfaces in the giant gaps on the dock
[*] NEW Fish at the fishmonger's stall can now be grabbed
[*] NEW Main Title screen is now skippable
[*] FIX Vender items that failed to unlock no longer disappear
[*] FIX Compass should no longer fall through the ground
[*] FIX Compass now works properly after scene loading
[*] FIX Telescopes now work when there is more than one in the scene
[*] FIX Removed unwanted collision between ship and cabin door handle
[*] FIX Splash audio sources and particles now move properly with the player ship
[*] FIX Cannon audio no longer pops or artifacts when MANY cannons fire simultaneously
[*] FIX VR Hands will now only highlight one objects at a time
[*] FIX Main title text no longer renders always on top
[*] FIX Haptics are now working as expected
[*] FIX Black screen fade effect is no longer rendered by incorrect cameras
[*] FIX Ship wheel UI now turns the right way
[*] FIX NPCs now use the full range of random skin, hair, and clothing colors
[*] FIX NPCs no longer float in rare cases after their ship sinks
[*] CHANGE Reduced player ship drag
[*] CHANGE The 3rd person camera is now used by default on the Home island
[*] CHANGE Ships now sink more slowly and in more interesting ways
[*] CHANGE Voyages now wait 2 minutes before ending automatically
[*] CHANGE Raising the anchor while docked now begins an automatically selected Voyage
[*] CHANGE Flintlock reload time increased to 15 seconds
[/list]
